Services.

Transparent pricing for event, product and food photography in Tartu and across Estonia. All shoots include editing and high-resolution delivery via a private gallery. Travel beyond Tartu may add a small fee — happy to confirm exact cost when you write.

Event photography

Corporate events, conferences, exhibitions, concerts, weddings and private celebrations across Estonia. Discreet on-site work, with previews available sooner if needed for press or social.

First hour Edited gallery delivered within 5–10 days €90
Each additional hour Same-day continuous coverage €70
Half-day (4 h) Discounted package rate €300–€360
Full-day (8 h) Discounted package rate €550–€600

A typical 4-hour event yields 100–200 edited images. Travel beyond Tartu may add a small fee, agreed before booking.

Food & Product

Studio-style product images for e-commerce, packaging, brand pages and lookbooks. Food photography for restaurants, cafés and food brands — controlled studio setups or natural light on location.

Hourly rate From — depends on shot count and complexity From €100
Half-day (4 h) Studio or on-location, edited & delivered €350
Full-day (8 h) Studio or on-location, edited & delivered €600

Output is colour-corrected, retouched and delivered in the formats you need (web, print, social). Image-count packages quoted on request.
